flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi workflows/repccs/notice_creation/core (RepccsCreateNoticeController /v1/repccsWebhook, CreateNoticeServiceImpl.processRepccsCreateNotice, helpers/RepWebHookPayloadValidator, ValidationServices, NoticeRecordHelper, NoticeProcessingHelper). ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core (CreateNoticeController /repccsWebhook-create-notice: older copy), auth/filter/JwtFilter. ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant to this story
note: Status in the sheet: 'Requirement given - Gen flow'. There is no OCMS flow deck, so 'Sesuai' means the code does what the story text says. Real-time REPCCS receipt exists and is complete: webhook endpoint, payload validation, VON/OND/eVON/eOND saved in one request, starting stage, and an immediate reply. Two gaps: (1) an AN from REPCCS is only flagged an_flag Y and blocked from payment, the PS-ANS row is not created (only the CES path creates it, CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:764); (2) failures after validation (inside createNotice) do not mark the audit row as failed, so they do not reach the report. Related maintenance ticket, Closed/Prod deployed and not lowering any fit: OCMS-DF-2026-100 (intranet/internet saves separated, is_sync). Not provable from the repo: which endpoint REPCCS uses (private /v1/repccsWebhook or the older copy in ocmsadminapi), APIM configuration, the subscription key value, offence rule code table content per environment. Key validation is off in dev and uat (properties) and true only in prod. The older copy in ocmsadminapi stays open without JWT and without a key.
recommendation: Can be claimed for real-time receipt, validation, NOPO/UPL storage and the starting stage. Flag two gaps: REPCCS ANs without PS-ANS, and rejections inside createNotice not recorded in the audit. Ask URA/REPCCS to confirm the endpoint in use and disable the older copy in ocmsadminapi if it is unused.

steps.step: REPCCS sends each parking offence notice to OCMS in real time through one webhook call and OCMS accepts it immediately
steps.detail: POST /v1/repccsWebhook (RepccsCreateNoticeController.java:39-42) takes one notice per request. processRepccsCreateNotice (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:99) validates and creates the notice and answers in the same request (:168), so there is no queue or batch file. The Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header is compared with Key Vault only when ocms.repccs.key.validation.enabled=true: true in application-prod.properties:126, false in application-uat.properties:119 and dev. An older copy remains in ocmsadminapi (CreateNoticeController.java:46, /repccsWebhook-create-notice); JwtFilter lets it through without a JWT (JwtFilter.java:181) and it has no subscription key check. Which endpoint REPCCS really calls, the APIM routing, and whether REPCCS sends there: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Notice data from REPCCS is checked before it is accepted (mandatory fields, ANSFlag Y/N, subsystem label, offence code)
steps.detail: validateMandatoryFields (RepWebHookPayloadValidator.java:30-73) checks TransactionID, CaptureDateTime, OffenceCode, car park, OperatorID, vehicle data, ANSFlag must be Y or N (:169-176), fine amount, dates not in the future, and field lengths. The subsystem label must be 3-8 characters and its owner must be MEV_Vehicle, REPCCS_ENC or REPCCS_EHT (:178-211). The offence code must exist in the rule code table (:447-476). A validation failure is answered with 400 and a generic message (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:170-179). An existing notice no is answered with 226, which the controller turns into HTTP 200 with appCode OCMS-4000 (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:154-164, RepccsCreateNoticeController.java:60-70). The rule code data in each environment: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: A received Notice of Parking Offence (NOPO) is saved as a new notice in the intranet (VON, OND) and internet (eVON, eOND) records
steps.detail: The offence type (O/E/U/A/T) is looked up in the offence rule code table from OffenceCode and vehicle category (ValidationServices.java:215-218). createNoticeRecord (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:861-864) prepares the entities, then batchSaveNoticeRecords (:494-501) saves VON and OND in the intranet and, because payment.sync.enabled=true (application-prod.properties:100), eVON and eOND in the internet (NoticeRecordHelper.java:307-311). Intranet rows get is_sync N and become Y only after the internet save commits (NoticeRecordHelper.java:281-286); this is the OCMS-DF-2026-100 fix (Closed, Prod deployed), raised on the CES path but the same code is here. For labels 003-010 and 020-021 the notice no may be empty and OCMS generates it (NoticeValidationHelper): the number generation was not traced in detail.

steps.step: A received Advisory Notice (AN, ANSFlag Y) is recognised and saved as an AN that cannot be paid
steps.detail: The payload ANSFlag is mapped to an_flag (ValidationServices.java:126). When Y, the VON is saved with an_flag Y and payment_acceptance_allowed N (NoticeRecordHelper.java:591-598). OCMS also runs its own AN check for offence type O and vehicle types S/D/V/I (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:843-846), which adds eservice_message_code ANS when it passes (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:124-147). Missing on the REPCCS path: the PS-ANS row in suspended_notice and the suspension fields on the VON are only created when createWithAnsSuspension=true, and that flag is only set in the CES/Certis branch for labels 030-999 (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:764). processPS_ANS exists but is not called anywhere. So an AN from REPCCS is flagged and blocked from payment, but has no PS-ANS and, when ANSFlag is Y but the OCMS check does not pass, no ANS eservice message. Whether that is the intended REPCCS design: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: An unauthorised use of parking lots (UPL) notice with no vehicle number is recognised and saved
steps.detail: An unidentified vehicle is recognised by VehicleCategory 0, VehicleRegistration X and LicencePlate N.A (RepWebHookPayloadValidator.java:119-125). Vehicle number N.A is mapped to vehicle registration type X (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:690-693). For type X, setProcessingStagesForX is called (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:816): payment_acceptance_allowed N, composition_amount set to 0, eservice message BLOCK_PAYMENT, next stage DN1 (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:390-410). Offence type U comes from the rule code table lookup for category 0 (ValidationServices.java:215-218): whether that rule code row exists in the database: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: A saved notice gets its starting processing stage so OCMS can start processing it
steps.detail: V/S/D vehicles get last stage NPA and next stage ROV with payment allowed (setProcessingStagesForVSD, NoticeProcessingHelper.java:423-441). Type X (UPL) gets next stage DN1 with payment blocked (:390-410). The stages are filled before the VON is saved (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:816-819, then :864). The downstream crons that pick up ROV/DN1 belong to other stories and were not traced here.

steps.step: Every receipt is recorded in the audit transaction table and REPCCS gets the result at once (OK or rejected); failures can be traced
steps.detail: Before validation, saveAudit writes an ocms_web_txn_audit row with sender REP and status 0 (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:108, ValidationServices.java:235-261). Validation failures, duplicates, a wrong key and unexpected errors call updateAuditError so the status becomes 1 (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:133-185). Success is answered with message OK without noticeNo (RepccsCreateNoticeController.java:43-58). The gap: failures inside createNotice (offence type lookup failure, an exception in processSingleNotice, batch save failure, :503-509) are answered to REPCCS as failed (:526-531) but the audit row is never updated, so it stays status 0 and has no VON. The 'Notices Created by Enforcement Systems' report only reads VON rows and audit rows with status 1, so such rejections never show there. Most validation rejections are recorded correctly.
